question: Distinguish between emission line spectrum and absorption line spectrum of an atom.

options.A: An emission line spectrum has bright lines on a dark background and is produced when excited atoms emit definite wavelengths. An absorption line spectrum has dark lines on a bright continuous background and is produced when cooler atoms absorb selected wavelengths from continuous radiation. The absorbed wavelengths correspond to wavelengths emitted by the same atom.
options.B: An emission spectrum has dark lines on a bright background, while an absorption spectrum has bright lines on a dark background.
options.C: Both spectra are continuous and contain all wavelengths without gaps.
options.D: Emission and absorption spectra are formed by the same process: reflection of white light.
